title: Business Development Executive
summary: A business development executive finds and wins new clients for a company that sells services or products to businesses or households, mostly through calls and in-person meetings. The role sits in the sales team of service firms and SMEs, reports to a sales or business development manager, and is measured on new closures each month.
dailyDuties: Build lead lists and make cold calls to set up meetings
Visit prospects at their offices, factories or shops
Understand client needs and prepare proposals and quotations
Follow up and negotiate price and terms to close deals
Update leads and deal stages in the CRM
Report daily visits and monthly closures to the manager

skills.expectation: Generate new leads every week through cold calling, emails, referrals and networking
Meet prospects in person at their offices, factories or shops in an assigned area
Prepare proposals, quotations and presentations that fit each client's needs
Close new business against monthly revenue or client targets
Negotiate price, scope and payment terms within approval limits
Keep leads, meetings and deal stages up to date in a CRM
Pitch confidently in English and the local language in meetings and on calls
Check a prospect's need, budget and decision maker before investing time
Review the pipeline and follow up on open proposals
Map the local market and competitors to find target segments
Forecast the month's closures for the manager
Maintain lead lists and daily sales reports
